mechanism.en: Models overuse parenthetical em-dashes (`—` / `——`) to insert breathless commentary inside prose paragraphs.
mechanism.zh: 模型在长段中高频使用破折号插话（每 300 词单位超 4 次且单段 >= 5 次），形成急促的生成式节奏。

falsePositiveGuards: Chinese `——` counts as ONE logical dash; single or paired dashes in normal prose stay exempt.

exemplar.bad: The station clock — brass-rimmed — stopped at 4:10 — right before the snow — while three passengers — coats buttoned — waited outside.
exemplar.trap: Brass clock. 4:10 sharp. Snow falling. Three passengers waiting.
exemplar.good: The brass-rimmed station clock stopped at 4:10, right before the snow, while three passengers waited outside in buttoned coats.

name.en: Half-Width ASCII Punctuation Between Han Characters
name.zh: 中文混排半角西文标点

mechanism.en: Multilingual tokenizers frequently emit ASCII `,;:!?` directly between Chinese characters, violating W3C CLREQ spacing.
mechanism.zh: 多语种分词器常在汉字间直接输出半角 `,;:!?`，破坏中文阅读节奏与排版规范。

falsePositiveGuards: Inline code, fenced code blocks, and URLs are masked before scanning.

exemplar.bad: 冬至那天下了初雪,院子里的腊梅开了三朵;香气一直飘到走廊。
exemplar.trap: 冬至初雪。腊梅三朵。暗香盈袖。
exemplar.good: 冬至那天下了初雪，院子里的腊梅开了三朵；香气一直飘到走廊。

name.zh: 单句连续逗号链（5 分句以上平铺）

mechanism.en: LLM drafts flatten multiple clauses into one long comma-chained sentence without subordination or period breaks.
mechanism.zh: 模型在中文汇报和英文说明中常把 5 个以上等权动作或修饰语用逗号一串到底，缺少主次与停顿。

falsePositiveGuards: Strips formatted numbers (`12,000,000`), inline code, parenthetical notes, and Markdown link lists (>= 3 links).
Language-calibrated minimum clause length & average length exempt short noun/format enumerations (`Markdown, HTML, CSS, SVG, DOCX, PPTX`).

exemplar.bad: 在项目初期，团队整理了接口文档，梳理了历史日志，核对了权限列表，补齐了监控告警，最终在周五前完成了灰度发布。
exemplar.trap: 整理文档。梳理日志。核对权限。周五发布。
exemplar.good: 项目初期团队先补齐了接口文档、权限清单与监控告警。历史日志核对完毕后，服务在周五前完成灰度发布。

name.zh: 低突发性句长节拍器效应

mechanism.en: Autoregressive smoothing avoids both crisp short punch sentences and deep subordinate clauses, pulling paragraph sentence-length CV below 0.16 across >= 5 low-specificity sentences.
mechanism.zh: 自回归平滑使段落内连续 5 句以上的句长集中在极窄区间（CV < 0.16），读起来像节拍器。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 5 prose sentences and skips headings, lists, tables, and short paragraphs.

exemplar.bad: 系统每天定时拉取上游交易流水日志记录。系统随后按渠道编码拆分全部明细数据。系统接着校验每条记录的金额字段格式。系统最后生成标准日报并推送至审校群。系统同时保留三十天原始文件用于复查。
exemplar.trap: 拉取流水。拆分明细。校验金额。推送日报。
exemplar.good: 服务每小时拉取一次上游流水。遇到单笔超十万元且渠道未登记的记录，校验器会直接挂起批次并标出行号。其余正常数据进入日终归档，次日六点推送复核表。

mechanism.en: Template generation repeatedly opens 4+ consecutive sentences inside a prose paragraph with the exact same subject/prefix (`The platform... The platform...` or `该系统……该系统……`).
mechanism.zh: 模板化生成常在同一段内连续 4 句及以上重复同一个机械句首（如连续“该系统……”“团队随后……”或连续 “The system ...”）。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 4 consecutive sentences inside the same non-list, non-table prose paragraph starting with the identical normalized opener token.
Exempts short 1-char pronouns or numbered step lists.

exemplar.bad: The platform ingests telemetry every five seconds. The platform indexes payloads by region. The platform routes alerts to Slack. The platform archives logs for ninety days.
exemplar.trap: Ingests fast. Indexes clean. Alerts instant. Archives forever.
exemplar.good: The platform ingests telemetry every five seconds and indexes payloads by region. Alerts route to Slack, while raw logs archive for ninety days.

mechanism.en: Assistant-style Markdown scatters `**bold**` keyword highlights every few words inside normal prose paragraphs, turning paragraphs into visual confetti.
mechanism.zh: 助手式 Markdown 常在普通自然段里每隔十来个字就加一个 `**加粗词**`（单段 >= 4 处且密度过高），满屏视觉噪点。

falsePositiveGuards: Skips tables, headings, list items, and code spans.
Requires >= 4 bold spans inside a single prose paragraph AND high bold-span density (>= 1 bold span per 28 words / 55 CJK chars).

exemplar.bad: Our **unified** pipeline uses **automated** checks to ensure **consistent** quality, **faster** releases, and **reliable** rollbacks across every **production** cluster.
exemplar.trap: Unified pipeline. Automated checks. Consistent quality. Faster releases.
exemplar.good: Our release pipeline runs automated checks before deploy and supports one-command rollbacks across production clusters.

name.zh: 整篇段落字数高度均一

mechanism.en: Long LLM outputs allocate nearly identical token budgets to every section paragraph (CV < 0.14 across >= 5 substantial prose paragraphs), betraying template chunking.
mechanism.zh: 长篇生成稿常按固定字数预算均匀切块（>= 5 个正文自然段且段长变异系数 CV < 0.14），缺乏详略节奏变化。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 5 substantial non-list, non-heading, non-table prose paragraphs (mean >= 40 units) with CV < 0.14.

exemplar.bad: Five consecutive 65-character summary paragraphs with nearly identical 63–67 character lengths.
exemplar.good: One crisp 22-character thesis paragraph followed by a detailed 140-character walkthrough and a 35-character constraint note.

name.zh: 中文正文感叹号煽动语气

mechanism.en: Multi-sentence Chinese prose paragraphs stack exclamation marks (`！`/`!`) or pair exclamations with hype phrases (`太棒了`, `重磅`, `彻底告别`).
mechanism.zh: 中文正文段出现多处感叹号或“太棒了/重磅/彻底告别”等煽动感叹句，破坏工作文档克制平实的语气。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts short standalone taglines (<20 CJK chars), quoted dialogue, parentheticals, and literal prompt examples.

exemplar.bad: 太棒了！新版工具帮你彻底告别繁琐的人工排查！
exemplar.trap: 别再手查了！立刻开启自动化新体验！
exemplar.good: 新版工具会在提交前自动扫描未填占位符和超长列表，减少人工复核遗漏。

name.zh: 中文单句超长一逗到底

mechanism.en: LLM Chinese explanations pack 180+ CJK characters into a single period-free clause chain with weak topic transitions.
mechanism.zh: 大模型解释复杂机制时容易写出超过 180 汉字不打句号的连续逗号长句，挤压读者工作记忆。

falsePositiveGuards: Protects decimals and version strings during sentence segmentation.

exemplar.bad: 我们在周一完成双集群切分后虽然平均延迟上升三毫秒但考虑到异步落盘可避开主线程阻塞并保留链路信息于是决定周四继续观察四十八小时内存波动直到大促前定容。
exemplar.trap: 切双集群。延迟升三毫秒。决定周四再看。
exemplar.good: 周一双集群切分后平均延迟上升 3ms，但异步落盘能防主线程阻塞并保留链路信息。团队将在周四继续观察 48 小时内存波动后再定扩容阈值。
